value.rationale: A naturally measurable multi-gap dependence invariant for synchronously reset many-particle systems is classified completely across all finite-second-moment clock laws: periodic clock is uniquely least correlating but still yields 1/10; optimally heterogeneous laws approach 1/2; every intermediate value is feasible. The invariant is not a routine one-gap normalization or arbitrary parameter slice; it quantifies an unavoidable form of induced collective edge-crowding dependence.
